7. Methane gas is also called marsh gas, why?
Ans:- Methane is commonly referred to as marsh gas because it is naturally produced in wetlands, swamps, and marshes
through the decay of organic matter.
8. Butyne is called unsaturated hydrocarbon, why?
Ans:- Butyne (C4H6) is classified as an unsaturated hydrocarbon because it contains a triple bond between two of its carbon atoms.
